title: ChatHealthy Specialty Classification Catalog (F-105)
description: ChatHealthy proprietary NUCC taxonomy overlay. The single source of the ChatHealthy-specific flags carried for every NUCC code, and the home of the regulator-only codes NUCC itself does not publish. An entry with is_supplemented.value true carries the NUCC-equivalent metadata inline, because there is no NUCC row to look it up in. Each entry carries a canonical URL, the catalog URL with the code as its anchor. See NUCC_SpecialtyCodeDataDiscrepancyManagement.docx for governance.

url.description: The canonical URL of this catalog. Per-entry URLs extend it by appending #<code> as the anchor.
Canonical per-entry URL = catalog URL + '#' + code.

value.description: True for entries whose code is not in current NUCC; false for normal NUCC-backed entries.

note.description: Curator note explaining the supplement provenance. Required when value=true.

display_name.description: Authoritative NUCC-equivalent display label for this code (used as taxonomies[i].code_label on provider records). Required on supplement entries so downstream consumers get a proper label instead of a derived-from-specialization fallback like 'Surgical' when the intended label is 'Surgical Technologist'.

psychiatric_facility.description: True if this taxonomy belongs to the psychiatric facility bucket. Membership, not derivation: the bucket cross-cuts NUCC Grouping, spanning psychiatric, behavioural and substance-use facilities, so no Grouping test produces it. Intellectual and developmental disability facilities are deliberately excluded.
